stages.journal: The Barrowlight lies somewhere inside the barrow of the Ashen Order. Find a way in.
A sealed bronze door bars the way deeper into the barrow. Its three sigils (sun, moon, and skull) must hold the key.
The bronze door stands open. Whatever guards the Barrowlight waits in the Barrow Heart beyond.
The guardian of the Barrow Heart no longer stands in your way. Claim the Barrowlight.
The Barrowlight burns in your hand, and its waking flame has unsealed a hidden stair beneath the sarcophagus leading deep into the earth.
You carried the Barrowlight down through the unsealed threshold into the Under-Barrow.
